name: ANCContactDecisionSupport
title: Antenatal care: contact decision support (WHO SMART, pilot)
description: Checks the current antenatal care contact for danger signs, pre-eclampsia and hypertension, gestational diabetes, anaemia, and whether HIV and syphilis tests are due, and says what to do: proceed, refer, test or counsel. Source: WHO antenatal care recommendations (2016), Digital Adaptation Kit (2021), implemented with 6 unmodified WHO SMART ANC decision tables (CQL).
usage: Pilot. Evaluates the data of one ANC contact, at its start (encounter-start) or at its end (encounter-discharge): the encounter is context.encounterId. Needs the Observations of that encounter, coded with the WHO ANC data dictionary codes or, through a curated binding, SNOMED CT; the ANC contact number is an Encounter extension. The data can be captured with the IG's Questionnaires (ANC.B5 Quick check, ANC.B6 Profile, ANC.B8 Physical exam, ANC.B9 Lab tests & imaging). WHO SMART ANC IG 0.3.0 (continuous integration build, not a published release).
